symbols.read: Price has broken below the 739.63–739.88 demand zone and the 737.02 invalidation level, sliding to 733.86 — the bullish cushion from the prior read is gone and the 1H downtrend is now confirmed rather than nascent. The overhead bear FVG at 745.09–746.32 is the only remaining gap, so the layered supply that previously capped bounces has thinned, but price sits well beneath it with no demand structure between here and the 722.40 lower pivot. The bias shifts from HOLD to bearish-leaning: the 4H remains technically bullish, but the combined signal is now a setup arming the SELL at 722.40, with 686.36 as the target once 722.40 gives way. Invalidation of this bearish read is a reclaim of 737.02 and then the 745.09–746.32 FVG; holding below 737.02 keeps 722.40 in play.

The bearish lean is confirmed and extended: price has slid from 82,850.27 to 81,967.91, breaking below the 82,413.00 continuation trigger, and the 4H direction has now flipped to bearish with the combined 4H+1H reading at SELL — a clear deterioration from the prior "neutral-to-bearish" stance where the 4H still read bullish. The overhead bear FVG stack (83,015–83,404 and 83,484–84,083) remains intact as supply, and a new bear gap at 82,531–82,647 now caps the immediate bounce, with the last 1H bar down -0.31% into the close. Bias is bearish toward the 80,684.36 lower pivot, which is the regime line; a reclaim of 82,647 and then the 83,015–83,404 gap would be the first sign of repair, while invalidation of the bearish case requires a full reclaim of the 83,713.91 pivot and the 83,484–84,083 gap.

The bearish bias remains confirmed and has extended: price has dropped to 2,409.41, breaking below the 2,445.84–2,448.12 and 2,482.49–2,484.34 FVGs from the prior read, leaving only the 2,453.97–2,472.90 bear FVG as overhead supply. The 1H trend is now explicitly down (2,433.48→2,430.27), and the combined 4H+1H signal is SELL, so the prior "sell rallies into 2,445–2,472" stance shifts lower — that zone is now distant resistance rather than the immediate cap. The BUY setup stays dead (entry 2,478.00, stop 2,481.87, target 2,627.00 all far above), and with the 2,329.00 lower pivot as the next magnet, the path of least resistance is toward it. Invalidation still requires a reclaim of 2,478.00 and a close through the 2,486.28–2,491.08 FVG; the BULLISH regime tag is stale and contradicted by the 4H/1H structure, so it does not soften the bearish read.

The bearish bias remains confirmed and has extended further, with price now at 103.82 after breaking below the prior 105.48 low and pressing toward the 100.43 lower pivot. The stacked bear FVGs have grown to four (106.29–106.97, 105.81–105.92, 105.21–105.25, 104.68–104.72), with the newest gap at 104.68–104.72 now sitting directly overhead and capping any bounce, while the 1H trend stays down and the combined read holds SELL. The BUY setup remains invalidated and moot, with entry 108.25 far above price. Bias stays bearish with 100.43 as the downside magnet; invalidation is a reclaim and hold above 108.25, which would neutralize the stacked gaps and revive the 116.07 target.

Price has extended the bearish leg to 55.93 from 56.36, and the 1H trend remains down (56.16→55.93, -0.41%), confirming the prior bearish bias — the layered bear FVGs between 56.79 and 57.47 remain overhead supply and price is now approaching the 55.37 target. The short entry/stop cluster (58.41/58.58) is now marked EXPIRED and sits far above price, so the original entry is fully stale; combined stays SELL with 4H bearish. Bias remains bearish toward 55.37, with the invalidation unchanged: a sustained reclaim of 58.41 flips the read bullish toward 61.45.

The bearish bias is confirmed and the thesis continues to play out, with price at 4,088.01 now below the prior 4,092.30 and pressing toward the 4,065.48 target (~22.5 points below). The 4,141.44 level remains the upper pivot and flipped resistance, with the stacked bearish FVGs at 4,126.37–4,130.31 and 4,131.15–4,132.33 still overhead as supply; the 1H leg is down but decelerating (-0.11% vs -0.58% prior), so momentum is softening even as structure holds. The 4,217.40 upper pivot sits well above as the broader 4H ceiling, keeping the combined 4H+1H read firmly SELL. Invalidation is unchanged: a sustained close back above 4,141.44 neutralizes the bearish structure, with 4,148.48 the hard stop for any residual short.

Bias has flipped from testing to breaking: price fell from 1.35 to 1.33, losing the upper pivot and confirming the bear FVG at 1.3532–1.3633 as active overhead supply, while the 1H trend has now turned down and the 4H BUY signal remains expired with the combined stance still HOLD. The 1.35 level that was the line in the sand is now resistance rather than support, and the 1.26 lower pivot is the next downside objective; the 1.44 target is effectively off the table until supply is cleared. Invalidation of the bearish read is a reclaim of 1.3633, which would be the first sign of repair, while a sustained hold below 1.33 keeps the path toward 1.26 open.
